name: Email Templates for Contact Form 7
author: lapashanga

sections.description:
🎭 Story Time: Sarah Has a Small Business

The Problem:
* Her confirmation emails look like plain text spam (“You sent a message…”). Clients don’t trust them.
* She forgets to follow up with leads who asked for quotes but didn’t book.
* She misses leads on weekends because she doesn’t check her inbox constantly.
* Her VA needs to know immediately when a “VIP Booking Request” comes in, but regular inquiries can wait.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚀 Step-by-Step Usage & Benefits

1. The “Wow” First Impression (Template Engine)

Action: Sarah installs our plugin. She goes to Email Templates, selects her “Request a Quote” form, and clicks “Add New Rule.”

Configuration:
* Send To: Defaults to mail_2 (Client).
* Template: She picks the “Tropical Vacation” HTML template (beautiful images, clear layout).
* Identity Protection: She sets From Name to “Sarah from Wanderlust” and Reply-To to support@wanderlust.com.

💡 Benefit: When a client submits a quote request, they instantly receive a gorgeous, branded email that looks like it came from a major travel corporation. It builds immediate trust. If the client hits “Reply,” it goes to Sarah’s support inbox, not back to the client’s own email address.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

2. Smart Routing for Peace of Mind (Conditional Routing)

Action: Sarah creates a second rule for the same form.

Configuration:
* Condition: If “Budget” field contains “$5000” OR “Type” is “VIP”.
* Send To: mail (Admin).
* Template: A simple, urgent “High Value Lead Alert.”
* Slack Integration: She checks “Notify Slack” and selects her #vip-leads channel.

💡 Benefit: Regular leads go to her general inbox. But the moment a high-value client applies, her phone buzzes with a Slack notification. She drops everything to call them personally. She never misses a big sale again.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

3. The “Set It and Forget It” Follow-Up (Automation Triggers)

Action: Sarah realizes she loses 30% of leads because she gets busy and forgets to follow up after 3 days.

Configuration: She goes to the new Automations tab.
* Trigger: “3 Days after submit.”
* Condition: Only if status is NOT “Replied” (using the Inbox feature).
* Action: Send the “Still Thinking? Here’s a 5% Discount” template.

💡 Benefit: The plugin automatically nags potential clients for her. If she already replied manually, the automation cancels itself (smart logic). If she didn’t, the system sends a persuasive follow-up email while she sleeps. This directly recovers lost revenue.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

4. Centralized Management (Submission Inbox & Settings)

Action: On Monday morning, Sarah opens the Settings > Submission Inbox (or the dedicated Inbox page).

Experience: She sees a list of all submissions.
* 🟢 Green dot: Replied.
* 🔴 Red dot: Pending.
* She can see exactly which automation fired and if the client opened the email (Analytics).

💡 Benefit: She doesn’t have to dig through Gmail threads. She has a CRM-lite view right inside WordPress. She knows exactly which leads are warm and which need attention.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💰 The Bottom Line for Sarah

Before our plugin:
❌ Looked unprofessional.
❌ Lost leads due to forgotten follow-ups.
❌ Missed VIP alerts on weekends.
❌ Spent 5 hours/week managing emails manually.

After our plugin:
✅ Professionalism: Clients trust her brand immediately due to beautiful templates.
✅ Revenue: Automated follow-ups recover 10-15% of lost leads automatically.
✅ Efficiency: Slack alerts ensure VIPs get instant service; smart routing filters noise.
✅ Time Savings: Saves her 5+ hours a week on manual emailing and tracking.

Why she pays $79/year:

She calculates that one recovered booking from an automated follow-up pays for the plugin for three years. It’s not an expense; it’s a profit generator.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📋 Core Features

  • 🎨 Free Templates – A set of free templates for newsletters, announcements, and more.
  • ✏️ Visual Template Editor – Edit placeholder fields with live preview of the email.
  • 📧 Client-Friendly HTML – Layouts designed to display well in Gmail, ProtonMail, Apple Mail, Yahoo Mail, and Outlook.
  • ➕ Add to Contact Form – One-click “Add to Contact Form” to create a CF7 form from your template.
  • 👁️ Live Preview – Preview any template before using it.
  • 💾 Saved Templates – Save your customized versions and edit them later.
  • ⚙️ Automation Triggers (Pro) – Set up automated follow-ups based on time delays and submission status.
  • 🔧 Rule Builder (Pro) – Create advanced conditional rules for email routing and actions.
  • 🔔 Slack Integration (Pro) – Get instant notifications in your Slack channels for important submissions.
  • 📊 Open/Click Tracking (Pro) – Track when recipients open emails and click links.
  • 🔄 Conditional Routing (Pro) – Route emails to different recipients based on form field values.
  • 📥 Submission Inbox (Pro) – Manage all form submissions in a centralized inbox with status tracking.
  • 📜 Template Versioning (Pro) – Save and manage multiple versions of the same template.
  • 🏆 Premium Templates (Pro) – Access exclusive professional templates for various industries.

⭐ Premium (Pro) Features

Upgrade to Pro for access to all premium templates and extra features:

Some Visuals:
https://templates.la-pash.store/how_to

To Your Inbox:
https://templates.la-pash.store/marketplace/test

Get the Pro version here:
https://templates.la-pash.store/plugins/email_templates_contact_form_7

Free Trial ( No Credit Card ):
https://templates.la-pash.store/plugins/email_templates_contact_form_7

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 plugin installed and activated
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Contact Form 7.
  2. Install and activate Email Templates for Contact Form 7.
  3. Go to Email Templates in the admin menu (or Contact → Email Templates depending on your setup).
  4. Use the Saved or Free filter to browse templates, or click Use template to open the editor.
  5. In the editor, fill in the fields and click Save Changes. The selected template can be used as your Contact Form 7 mail body (no HTML editing) and includes one-click Add to Contact Form. Pro users get premium templates, multiple versions, and the Submission Inbox.
sections.faq:
Do I need Contact Form 7?

Yes. This plugin adds email templates that are used as the mail body (and optionally mail 2) in Contact Form 7. CF7 must be installed and activated.

Can I preview templates without upgrading?

Yes. You can browse all free templates from the listing page.

What’s the difference between free and Pro?

Free: access to free templates, visual editor + live preview, saved versions, and using the template as your CF7 mail body, plus one-click “Add to Contact Form.” Pro: access to premium templates, multiple versions per template (v1, v2, v3), and the Submission Inbox.
